title: Dashboard
subtitle: A clean React starter with strict contracts, modular generators, and a shadcn-ready design foundation.
tailwindNativeDesc: Components rely on utility classes and theme tokens instead of legacy CSS selectors.
strictContractsDesc: The template keeps strictly typed component props and avoids loose assumptions.
modularBaseDesc: Shared UI, layout, feedback, and feature scaffolds stay organized for generated modules.
i18nReadyDesc: Full enterprise internationalization support with instant language switching between English and Indonesian.
